Hi Marcus —

Thanks for reaching out and for the kind words about my React work. I’m interested in the analytics dashboard — this is well within my experience (real-time charts, auth/RBAC, responsive design, dark mode).

A few quick questions to scope the work and confirm timing:
1) For real-time visualization, do you need streaming (WebSockets) or periodic polling from the REST API? Do you have a preferred charting library (D3, Chart.js, Recharts) or are you open to recommendations?
2) Can you share a sample of the REST API (endpoints, auth method) or should I build mock endpoints for the MVP?
3) For authentication and RBAC, do you already have a user service (OAuth / JWT / SSO) or should I implement a new auth layer integrated with your existing system?
4) Are the designs available (Figma/Sketch) or would you like me to propose UI/UX for the core pages first?
5) Preferred start date and availability for a 30-minute kickoff call to align on scope and deliverables?

Estimated guess: based on what you described, a focused 4-week MVP (real-time charts, integration with REST API, basic auth + RBAC, responsive layouts) should fit the $5k–$6k range if the API and data access are ready. If you’d like, I can put together a short proposal with milestones and a timeline after we confirm the answers above.

Looking forward to hearing more — I’m available for a call most afternoons next week.

Best,
Jordan Mitchell
ML Engineer | jordan.mitchell@email.com
